summary: The aggregated `leggi cerca` path must emit the same --frase degradation warning as --dry-run and the non-aggregated search path.
reason: When --frase hits a non-droppable ISIS operator alias (meno, no, seguito, …), the AggregaLeggi branch returned before fraseHint and warnPertinenza ran, so the live CLI and MCP envelope exposed results without the warning.
validated_outcome: uniscoHint(hintLeggiCorte(...), fraseHint(--frase "aree meno idonee")) keeps the truncation hint and includes the «meno» warning.
